title: 第4章 重生第5章 商量
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 就在楚安芷沉浸在自己的绝世容颜回不过神来的时候，楚未也回到了属于他的洞府。
他看着十分简陋的山洞，哪怕有心理准备，还是忍不住嘴角抽抽。
哪怕前世被某个不要脸的丢下悬崖，最落魄的时候，也知道给自己睡觉的地方铺个草垫子，更何况后来自己成为一代邪尊，住的都是大房子，至少该有的都有。
楚未抬头望天（山洞顶），想当年自己还没被捡回观世宗的时候，那可是要风得风，要雨得雨的少爷，虽说有很多东西要忙，但至少生活品质那是杠杠的。
没错，现在的楚未，哦不对，应该叫赵归涯，他不光是重生的，他还记起了被捡回观世宗前15年的记忆，又想起自己是为何失忆。
赵归涯垂眸，然后心虚的摸了摸自己的鼻子，额……好吧，多少有自己作死的成份。
他站在自己简陋的洞府中央，抬手打了个响指，指尖跃动着一簇幽蓝色的火焰。
“啧，连个照明阵法都没有。”
他撇了撇嘴，随手将火焰弹向四周石壁。
幽蓝火光所到之处，粗糙的石壁上立刻浮现出繁复的暗纹，一个阵法形成，整个洞府瞬间亮如白昼。
赵归涯满意的点了点头，虽然现在实力是金丹初期，但前世自己捣鼓的一些偏低阶阵法（简化版），还是可以随手丢的。
他踱步到那张硬邦邦的石床前，从身上拿出一个储物袋（楚安芷旧旧的同款），然后从里面掏出来一套鸦青色的床上三件套，外加棉芯、枕头和床垫。
把它们摆到石床上，赵归涯右手中指敲了一下食指指甲盖。
只见床上的东西开始自动组装了起来，不消片刻铺的平平整整的床铺就铺好了。
幸亏自己不是修炼狂，也没老婆剑要养，存了不少灵币和下品灵石，发现自己重生且还在山下，就顺手买了不少东西回来。
说来搞笑，别的话本子里主角重生至少都要死上一死，他倒好睡个觉把自己睡回来了，刚重生回来他还以为做梦呢。
要不是手上刚买的装有辟谷丹的玉瓶触感格外真实，还有脑海里突然记起的记忆，不然他真以为做梦呢。
就说嘛，他前世都快是真仙的人了，竟然还会做梦。
赵归涯叹了口气，随后就往床上一摊，动作间哪里还有半点在楚安芷面前那副纯良小徒弟的模样？
看着空荡荡的洞府，赵归涯换了个姿势：“下次搞个吊床试试。”
“不过现在嘛。”
他单手支着头，另一只手无意识地摩挲着脸上的银质面具，琥珀色的眸子里闪过一丝玩味。
他轻声自语，“这次醒来的师尊，神魂似乎彻底凝实了呢～”
虽说实力没有跟回来，刻入神魂的力量倒是跟回来了，就如他现在可以直接透过皮囊看到神魂模样。
赵归涯的指尖轻轻点了点面具边缘，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑。
“原来是会心虚的呀。”
随后凝了一个水镜出来，然后缓缓的摘下面具。
只见镜中人长得极其好看，
双眉斜飞入鬓，眉眼间距过短，给人一种压迫感，但一双柳叶眼微微上挑，眼尾弧度似狐狸般狡黠。
琥珀色的瞳仁在昏暗的光线下泛着细碎的金芒，像是沉淀了千年的蜜糖，又像是藏着无数未说出口的算计和冷意。
鼻梁高挺，唇色如三月枝头最艳的桃花，天生微微上翘的唇角噙着一抹若有似无的笑。
唇下一点浅红的贪吃痣，像是雪地里落了一滴血，诱人得近乎妖异。
最引人注目的是他的肤色并非寻常修士的冷白，而是泛着暖玉般的莹润光泽，像是被阳光细细打磨过的琥珀，让人忍不住想伸手触碰，确认那是否真是人类的肌肤。
雌雄莫辨，却又丝毫不显女气。
像是雪地里突然绽放的红梅，艳丽夺目，却又带着刺骨的寒意。
赵归涯对自己的脸看了又看，最后咬牙切齿：“本尊何等绝色，姓楚的到底哪只眼睛看出本尊相貌丑如夜魔（一种长相畸形的种族），不戴面具不能见人的！”
最主要他还真信了，这就很绝。
突然不知赵归涯想到了什么，双眼微眯，一把挥散了水镜，从床上坐了起来，拿出储物袋颠了颠。
content_en:
Just when Chu Anzhi was immersed in her peerless appearance and couldn't recover, Chu Wei also returned to his cave.
He looked at the very simple cave, and even though he was mentally prepared, he couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Even if he was thrown off a cliff by someone shameless in his previous life, when he was at his lowest, he still knew how to lay a straw mat for his sleeping place. What's more, he later became an evil lord and lived in a big house, which at least had everything he should have.
Chu Wei looked up at the sky (the top of the cave), thinking that before he was picked up by Guanshi Sect, he was a young master who wanted wind and rain. Although he had many things to be busy with, at least his quality of life was excellent.
That's right, the current Chu Wei, oh no, should be called Zhao Guiya. Not only was he reborn, he also remembered the memories of the 15 years before he was picked up by Guan Shizong, and he also remembered why he lost his memory.
Zhao Guiya lowered his eyes, and then touched his nose with a guilty conscience. Well...well, it was somewhat of a suicide attempt.
He stood in the center of his simple cave, raised his hand and snapped his fingers, a cluster of blue flames dancing on his fingertips.
"Tsk, there isn't even a lighting formation."
He curled his lips and flicked the flames to the surrounding stone walls.
Wherever the faint blue firelight touched, complex dark patterns immediately appeared on the rough stone walls, and a formation formed, making the entire cave instantly bright as day.
Zhao Guiya nodded with satisfaction. Although his current strength was at the early stage of the Golden Core, he could still throw away some of the low-level formations (simplified versions) he had worked on in his previous life.
He walked over to the hard stone bed, took out a storage bag from his body (the same model as Chu Anzhi's old one), and then took out a three-piece crow-blue bed set, plus cotton cores, pillows and mattresses.
Putting them on the stone bed, Zhao Guiya tapped the nail of his index finger with the middle finger of his right hand.
I saw that the things on the bed began to assemble themselves, and the flat bed was laid out in just a few moments.
Fortunately, I wasn't a cultivator, and I didn't have a wife or sword to keep. I had saved a lot of spiritual coins and low-grade spiritual stones. When I found out that I was reborn and was still at the bottom of the mountain, I bought a lot of things back.
It's funny, otherwise the main character in the book would die at least once when he was reborn. He had to take a nap and fall back asleep. He thought it was a dream when he was reborn.
If it weren't for the fact that the jade bottle containing Bigu Pill he just bought felt so real to the touch, and the memory that suddenly came to his mind, he would have thought he was dreaming.
Let's just say that he was almost a true immortal in his previous life, yet he still had dreams.
Zhao Guiya sighed, and then he lay down on the bed. Where could he still look like the innocent little disciple in front of Chu Anzhi?
Looking at the empty cave, Zhao Guiya changed his position and said, "I'll try to get a hammock next time."
"But now."
He supported his head with one hand, and the other hand unconsciously rubbed the silver mask on his face, a trace of amusement flashed in his amber eyes.
"Interesting..."
He whispered to himself, "Master, when he woke up this time, his soul seemed to be completely solid~"
Although the strength did not come back, the power carved into the soul did come back, just like he could now see the soul directly through the skin.
Zhao Guiya's fingertips lightly tapped the edge of the mask, and a meaningful smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"It turns out he has a guilty conscience."
Then a water mirror came out, and then he slowly took off the mask.
I saw that the person in the mirror looked extremely good-looking.
The eyebrows fly diagonally into the temples, and the distance between the eyebrows is too short, giving people a sense of oppression. However, a pair of willow-leaf eyes are slightly raised, and the arc at the end of the eyes is as cunning as a fox.
The amber pupils glowed with fine golden light in the dim light, like honey that had been deposited for thousands of years, and seemed to contain countless unspoken calculations and cold intentions.
The bridge of the nose is high, the color of the lips is like the most beautiful peach blossoms on the branches in March, and there is a faint smile on the corners of the naturally slightly upturned lips.
The light red greedy mole under her lip looked like a drop of blood in the snow, so alluring that it was almost enchanting.
The most striking thing is that his skin color is not the cold white of ordinary monks, but has a warm jade-like luster, like amber that has been carefully polished by the sun. People can't help but want to reach out and touch it to confirm whether it is really human skin.
Indistinguishable between male and female, yet not feminine at all.
Like the sudden blooming of red plums in the snow, they are eye-catching and yet piercingly chilly.
Zhao Guiya looked at his face again and again, and finally gritted his teeth: "I am so beautiful. Which eye of the Chu people can tell that I am as ugly as a night devil (a race with deformed appearance)? I can't see people without a mask!"
The most important thing is that he really believes it, which is amazing.
Suddenly Zhao Guiya thought of something. He narrowed his eyes slightly, waved away the water mirror, sat up from the bed, took out the storage bag and shook it.
